flags: Partial draft: cache supports designation, extent and planning context, but no road-specific landscape, curves, grades, overlooks, drive time or construction history. Three minimal moments describe the start, intervening highway and end, not invented attractions.

The Urban Service Area boundary is not the Lexington municipal boundary. The cache does not establish its present position or whether later boundary changes alter the designated start; no junction or coordinates are invented.
Fayette Alliance’s advocacy is attributed. Its 2022 article calls 1996 the last expansion and gives 4,200 acres; Wikipedia gives 5,300 acres. Neither is used to describe current limits.

WKYT’s May 2026 corridor study has no mapped extent in the cache, so it is not assigned to this scenic segment. Greenbrier borders Winchester Road but is not established within the designated 4.8 miles; excluded. No current story exists.
